description: Rough AVM stitching layout for the CARLA vehicle.tesla.model3 rig, same structure and same pixels_per_meter/width/height as BYD_QinPro_white. Only the rig-dependent numbers were recomputed: car_origin_y so the centre of the four wheels lands on the image centre (wheel_base 3.005 m from car_info.json, origin is the rear axle centre, so car_origin_y = height/2 + wheel_base/2 * pixels_per_meter, rounded to an integer), and blind_x/y/width/height as the rectangle spanned by the four surround camera mounts in vector_dev/carla/scripts/surround_sensor_config.json (front 3.84 m, back -1.02 m, left +1.08 m, right -1.08 m from the rear axle) - the patch of ground between the cameras that none of them can see. Image axes follow ad_ext/TopdownCoordinate.py: image_x = car_origin_x - y * pixels_per_meter, image_y = car_origin_y - x * pixels_per_meter, with x forward and y left.

output.comment: output is the params needed by other components
